 660    def _read_csv_headers(self, path: str) -> list[str]:
 661        """
 662        Read a supported table and return its non-empty column names as normalized strings.
 663
 664        Args:
 665            path (str): Input file path to read or output file path to write.
 666
 667        Returns:
 668            list[str]: Normalized non-empty column names from the source table.
 669        """
 670        headers = self._read_table(path).columns.tolist()
 671        return [str(h).strip() for h in headers if h is not None]
 672
 673    def _read_table(self, path: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
 674        """
 675        Load a CSV or text table with utf8 BOM handling and a delimiter detection fallback.
 676
 677        Args:
 678            path (str): Input file path to read or output file path to write.
 679
 680        Returns:
 681            pd.DataFrame: Parsed CSV or text table.
 682
 683        Raises:
 684            ValueError: Raised when the file extension is not CSV or text.
 685        """
 686        ext = Path(path).suffix.lower()
 687        if ext not in {".csv", ".txt"}:
 688            raise ValueError("Only .csv and .txt files are supported.")
 689        try:
 690            return pd.read_csv(path, encoding="utf-8-sig")
 691        except Exception:
 692            return pd.read_csv(path, sep=None, engine="python", encoding="utf-8-sig")
 693        
 694    def _default_observer_y_column(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> str:
 695        """
 696        Choose a sensible default numeric y-axis column while avoiding common time/index columns.
 697
 698        Args:
 699            df (pd.DataFrame): Dataframe whose columns or values are inspected, cached, or registered.
 700
 701        Returns:
 702            str: Preferred numeric observer y-axis column, or a safe fallback column name.
 703        """
 704        cols = [str(col) for col in df.columns]
 705        preferred_block = {"epoch", "posix_time", "row_index"}
 706        for col in cols:
 707            if str(col).lower() in preferred_block:
 708                continue
 709            if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[col]):
 710                return str(col)
 711        for col in cols:
 712            if str(col).lower() not in preferred_block:
 713                return str(col)
 714        return cols[0] if cols else ""
 715
 716    def _default_observer_x_column(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> str:
 717        """
 718        Choose a sensible default observer x-axis column, preferring POSIX time, epoch, and recognized time columns.
 719
 720        Args:
 721            df (pd.DataFrame): Dataframe whose columns or values are inspected, cached, or registered.
 722
 723        Returns:
 724            str: Preferred time/index observer x-axis column, or row_index as a fallback.
 725        """
 726        for candidate in (POSIX_TIME_COL, "epoch"):
 727            if candidate in df.columns:
 728                return candidate
 729        time_candidates = candidate_time_columns(df)
 730        if time_candidates:
 731            return str(time_candidates[0])
 732        return "row_index"
 733
 734    def _register_observer_dataset(self, name: str, df: pd.DataFrame, *, path: str = "") -> None:
 735        """
 736        Add or replace a named imported dataset available for direct observer plotting while retaining its selection state.
 737
 738        Args:
 739            name (str): User-visible dataset, column, or derived-feature name.
 740            df (pd.DataFrame): Dataframe whose columns or values are inspected, cached, or registered.
 741            str: Source path retained for display and for re-identifying the imported dataset.
 742        """
 743        clean_name = name.strip() or f"dataset_{len(self.observer_datasets) + 1}"
 744        observer = ObserverDataset(name=clean_name, df=df, path=path, x_column=self._default_observer_x_column(df), y_column=self._default_observer_y_column(df))
 745        replaced = False
 746        for idx, existing in enumerate(self.observer_datasets):
 747            if existing.name == clean_name:
 748                was_selected = existing.name in self.observer_selected_dataset_names
 749                self.observer_datasets[idx] = observer
 750                if was_selected:
 751                    self.observer_selected_dataset_names.add(clean_name)
 752                replaced = True
 753                break
 754        if not replaced:
 755            self.observer_datasets.append(observer)
 756
 757    def _invalidate_observer_dataset_cache(self, dataset: ObserverDataset) -> None:
 758        """
 759        Clear a datasets cached numeric plotting arrays after its selected columns or source data change.
 760
 761        Args:
 762            dataset (ObserverDataset): Dataset object to inspect, mutate, cache, or select.
 763        """
 764        dataset.cached_plot_xs.clear()
 765        dataset.cached_plot_ys.clear()
 766        dataset.cached_x_column = ""
 767        dataset.cached_y_column = ""
 768        dataset.cache_ready = False
 769
 770    def _build_observer_dataset_cache(self, dataset: ObserverDataset) -> tuple[list[float], list[float], str, str]:
 771        """
 772        Coerce the selected observer columns into aligned numeric x/y arrays and cache the result for repeated observer rendering.
 773
 774        Args:
 775            dataset (ObserverDataset): Dataset object to inspect, mutate, cache, or select.
 776
 777        Returns:
 778            tuple[list[float], list[float], str, str]: Cached numeric x/y series and the columns used to create them.
 779        """
 780        if dataset.df.empty:
 781            self._invalidate_observer_dataset_cache(dataset)
 782            return [], [], dataset.x_column, dataset.y_column
 783
 784        df = dataset.df
 785        x_col = dataset.x_column if dataset.x_column in df.columns or dataset.x_column == "row_index" else self._default_observer_x_column(df)
 786        y_col = dataset.y_column if dataset.y_column in df.columns else self._default_observer_y_column(df)
 787
 788        if x_col == "row_index":
 789            x_series = pd.Series(range(len(df)), dtype=float)
 790        else:
 791            x_series = pd.to_numeric(df[x_col], errors="coerce")
 792
 793        y_series = pd.to_numeric(df[y_col], errors="coerce")
 794        valid_mask = x_series.notna() & y_series.notna()
 795
 796        dataset.cached_plot_xs = x_series[valid_mask].astype(float).tolist()
 797        dataset.cached_plot_ys = y_series[valid_mask].astype(float).tolist()
 798        dataset.cached_x_column = x_col
 799        dataset.cached_y_column = y_col
 800        dataset.cache_ready = True
 801
 802        return dataset.cached_plot_xs, dataset.cached_plot_ys, x_col, y_col
 803
 804    def _load_csv_and_open_headers(self, path: str) -> None:
 805        """
 806        Load a file into the backend and observer registry, initialize feature/target controls, and open the CSV-header selector.
 807
 808        Args:
 809            path (str): Input file path to read or output file path to write.
 810        """
 811        self.backend.load_data(path)
 812        df = self._read_table(path)
 813        headers = [str(h).strip() for h in df.columns.tolist() if h is not None]
 814        dataset_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(path))[0]
 815        self._register_observer_dataset(dataset_name, df, path=path)
 816        self.csv_path = path
 817        self.csv_headers = headers
 818        self.feature_mask = [False] * len(headers)
 819        self.target_index = -1
 820        self.new_target_index = -1
 821        self.show_csv_headers_window = True
 822        self.data_label = f"CSV: {os.path.basename(path)}"
 823        self.last_training_summary = {}
 824        self._clear_plot_state()
 825        self.set_status(f"Loaded into modeling suite: {path}")
 826
 827    def _start_import_formatting(self, paths: list[str]) -> None:
 828        """
 829        Prepare file-header and merge-option state before opening the multi-file import-format modal.
 830
 831        Args:
 832            paths (list[str]): Selected source-table paths prepared for multi-file import formatting.
 833        """
 834        if not paths:
 835            self.set_status("Select at least one data file first.")
 836            return
 837        
 838        self.import_candidate_paths = list(paths)
 839        self.import_file_headers = {path: self._read_csv_headers(path) for path in paths}
 840        header_sets = [set(headers) for headers in self.import_file_headers.values() if headers]
 841        self.import_common_merge_columns = sorted(set.intersection(*header_sets)) if header_sets else []
 842        self.import_merge_column_idx = 0
 843        self.import_merge_how_idx = 0
 844        self.import_posix_time_column_idx = 0
 845        self.import_posix_unit_idx = 0
 846        self.import_timezone_idx = 0
 847
 848        if len(paths) <= 1:
 849            self.import_merge_mode_idx = 0
 850        elif self.import_common_merge_columns:
 851            self.import_merge_mode_idx = 0
 852        else:
 853            self.import_merge_mode_idx = 1
 854        self.show_import_format_window = True
 855
 856    def _build_import_datasets(self) -> tuple[list[ProcessingDataset], dict[str, Any]]:
 857        """
 858        Build processing datasets from selected import files according to the configured keep, concatenate, feature-merge, or POSIX-time-merge mode.
 859
 860        Returns:
 861            tuple[list[ProcessingDataset], dict[str, Any]]: Constructed processing datasets and an import summary.
 862
 863        Raises:
 864            ValueError: Raised when no files are selected or the requested merge configuration cannot be satisfied.
 865        """
 866        paths = list(self.import_candidate_paths)
 867        if not paths:
 868            raise ValueError("No input files selected.")
 869        frames: list[tuple[str, pd.DataFrame]] = []
 870        for path in paths:
 871            frames.append((path, self._read_table(path)))
 872        source_rows = int(sum(len(df) for _, df in frames))
 873        merge_mode = self.import_merge_mode_options[self.import_merge_mode_idx]
 874        datasets: list[ProcessingDataset] = []
 875
 876        if len(frames) == 1 or merge_mode == "keep_separate":
 877            for path, df in frames:
 878                datasets.append(
 879                    ProcessingDataset(
 880                        name=os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(path))[0],
 881                        df=df.copy(),
 882                        source_paths=[path],
 883                    )
 884                )
 885            combine_mode = "keep_separate" if len(frames) > 1 else "single_file"
 886        elif merge_mode == "concat_rows":
 887            combined = pd.concat([df for _, df in frames], ignore_index=True, sort=False)
 888            datasets = [
 889                ProcessingDataset(
 890                    name="concatenated_import",
 891                    df=combined,
 892                    source_paths=paths,
 893                )
 894            ]
 895            combine_mode = "concat_rows"
 896        elif merge_mode == "merge_on_posix_time":
 897            if not self.import_common_merge_columns:
 898                raise ValueError("No shared time column is available across the selected files.")
 899
 900            time_col = self.import_common_merge_columns[self.import_posix_time_column_idx]
 901            posix_unit = self.processing_posix_units[self.import_posix_unit_idx]
 902            timezone = self.processing_timezones[self.import_timezone_idx]
 903
 904            temp_datasets: list[ProcessingDataset] = []
 905            for path, df in frames:
 906                temp_datasets.append(
 907                    ProcessingDataset(
 908                        name=os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(path))[0],
 909                        df=df.copy(),
 910                        source_paths=[path],
 911                        time_column=time_col,
 912                        timezone=timezone,
 913                        posix_unit=posix_unit))
 914
 915            merged = merge_datasets_on_posix(
 916                temp_datasets,
 917                merged_name="merged_import",
 918            )
 919
 920            datasets = [merged]
 921            combine_mode = f"merge_on_posix_time:{posix_unit}"
 922        else:
 923            if not self.import_common_merge_columns:
 924                raise ValueError("No shared merge column is available across the selected files.")
 925            merge_col = self.import_common_merge_columns[self.import_merge_column_idx]
 926            merge_how = self.import_merge_how_options[self.import_merge_how_idx]
 927            df = frames[0][1].copy()
 928            suffix_counter = 2
 929            for _, next_df in frames[1:]:
 930                df = pd.merge(df, next_df, on=merge_col, how=merge_how, suffixes=("", f"_{suffix_counter}"))
 931                suffix_counter += 1
 932            datasets = [
 933                ProcessingDataset(
 934                    name="merged_import",
 935                    df=df,
 936                    source_paths=paths,
 937                )
 938            ]
 939            combine_mode = f"merge_on_feature:{merge_how}"
 940
 941        summary = {
 942            "n_files": len(paths),
 943            "source_rows": source_rows,
 944            "n_datasets": len(datasets),
 945            "combine_mode": combine_mode,
 946            "paths": list(paths),
 947        }
 948
 949        if len(paths) > 1 and merge_mode == "merge_on_feature" and self.import_common_merge_columns:
 950            summary["merge_column"] = self.import_common_merge_columns[self.import_merge_column_idx]
 951            summary["merge_how"] = self.import_merge_how_options[self.import_merge_how_idx]
 952
 953        if len(paths) > 1 and merge_mode == "merge_on_posix_time" and self.import_common_merge_columns:
 954            summary["time_column"] = self.import_common_merge_columns[self.import_posix_time_column_idx]
 955            summary["posix_unit"] = self.processing_posix_units[self.import_posix_unit_idx]
 956            summary["timezone"] = self.processing_timezones[self.import_timezone_idx]
 957
 958        return datasets, summary
 959
 960    def confirm_import_format_and_load(self) -> None:
 961        """Commit the selected import configuration, populate the processing workspace, and report whether dataset construction succeeded."""
 962        try:
 963            datasets, summary = self._build_import_datasets()
 964            if not datasets:
 965                raise ValueError("No datasets were built from the selected files.")
 966            self.processing_datasets = datasets
 967            self.processing_active_dataset_idx = 0
 968            self.processing_selected_dataset_indices = {0}
 969            self.processing_selected_variables = set()
 970            self.show_processing_window = True
 971            self.show_import_format_window = False
 972            self.show_import_picker = False
 973            self.import_selected_files = []
 974            self.last_import_summary = summary
 975            self._sync_processing_selection()
 976            self.data_label = f"Processing suite: {len(datasets)} dataset(s) loaded"
 977            self.set_status(
 978                f"Loaded {len(datasets)} dataset(s) into the data processing suite from {summary.get('n_files', 1)} file(s)."
 979            )
 980        except Exception as exc:
 981            self.set_status(f"Import failed: {exc}")
 982
 983    # Data processing helper funcs
 984    def _sync_processing_selection(self) -> None:
 985        """Normalize active processing-dataset and selected-variable state after imports, deletions, or user selections."""
 986        if not self.processing_datasets:
 987            self.processing_active_dataset_idx = 0
 988            self.processing_selected_dataset_indices = set()
 989            self.processing_selected_variables = set()
 990            return
 991        self.processing_active_dataset_idx = max(0, min(self.processing_active_dataset_idx, len(self.processing_datasets) - 1))
 992        valid_indices = {idx for idx in self.processing_selected_dataset_indices if 0 <= idx < len(self.processing_datasets)}
 993        if not valid_indices:
 994            valid_indices = {self.processing_active_dataset_idx}
 995        self.processing_selected_dataset_indices = valid_indices
 996        active_ds = self.processing_datasets[self.processing_active_dataset_idx]
 997        active_cols = {str(col) for col in active_ds.df.columns}
 998        self.processing_selected_variables = {col for col in self.processing_selected_variables if col in active_cols}
 999

1100
1101        if not ds.pending_time_column:
1102            raise ValueError("Select a time feature first.")
1103
1104        if not ds.pending_timezone:
1105            raise ValueError("Select a timezone first.")
1106
1107        if not ds.pending_posix_unit:

1111        ds.timezone = ds.pending_timezone

1114
1115        ensure_posix_time(ds)

1117        self.set_status(

1293    def processing_downsample_selected_sets(self) -> None:
1294        """Create downsampled copies of the selected processing datasets using the configured method and window size."""
1295        try:
1296            datasets = self.selected_processing_datasets
1297            if len(datasets) < 1:
1298                raise ValueError("Select at least one dataset.")
1299            method = self.processing_downsample_methods[self.processing_downsample_idx]
1300            reference = None
1301            if 0 <= self.processing_reference_dataset_idx < len(self.processing_datasets):
1302                reference = self.processing_datasets[self.processing_reference_dataset_idx]
1303            outputs: list[ProcessingDataset] = []
1304            for ds in datasets:
1305                ref = None if reference is None or reference is ds else reference
1306                outputs.append(
1307                    downsample_dataset(ds, method=method, window=max(1, int(self.processing_downsample_window)), reference=ref)
1308                )
1309            for out in outputs:
1310                self._append_processing_dataset(out, select=False)
1311            self.set_status(f"Created {len(outputs)} downsampled dataset(s) using {method}.")
1312        except Exception as exc:
1313            self.set_status(f"Downsample failed: {exc}")

1349    def send_active_dataset_to_modeling(self) -> None:
1350        """Write the active processing dataset to a temporary CSV and load it into the model-configuration workflow."""
1351        try:

1353                raise ValueError("Send to Modeling Suite requires exactly one dataset in the processing suite. Merge first if needed.")
1354            ds = self.processing_datasets[0]
1355            if ds.time_column is None:

1358            temp_dir = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "simtwo_imports")

1360            safe_name = "".join(ch if ch.isalnum() or ch in ("-", "_") else "_" for ch in ds.name) or "dataset"

1462    def _timing_posix_column(self, dataset: ObserverDataset | None = None) -> str:
1463        """
1464        Find the POSIX-time column available for timing plots in the active or supplied observer dataset.
1465
1466        Args:
1467            ObserverDataset | None: Dataset to inspect; None uses the active observer dataset.
1468
1469        Returns:
1470            str | None: Available POSIX-time column name, or None when absent.
1471        """
1472        dataset = dataset or self.active_observer_dataset()
1473        if dataset is None or dataset.df.empty:
1474            return ""
1475        for candidate in (POSIX_TIME_COL, "posix_time"):
1476            if candidate in dataset.df.columns:
1477                series = pd.to_numeric(dataset.df[candidate], errors="coerce")
1478                if series.notna().sum() >= 2:
1479                    return candidate
1480        return ""
1481

1491    def timing_x_axis_status(self) -> str:
1492        """

1497        """

1501            return f"POSIX x-axis available from '{column}' in '{dataset.name}'." if dataset is not None else "POSIX x-axis available."

1504    def current_timing_plot_xs(self, epochs: list[int]) -> list[float]:
1505        """
1506        Return timing-plot x values using epochs or aligned POSIX-time values according to the selected axis mode.
1507
1508        Args:
1509            epochs (list[int]): Generated epoch indices used when POSIX time is not selected.
1510
1511        Returns:
1512            list[float]: X-axis values aligned to generated timing predictions.
1513        """
1514        if self.selected_timing_x_axis_mode != "posix_time":
1515            return [float(epoch) for epoch in epochs]
1516
1517        dataset = self.active_observer_dataset()
1518        column = self._timing_posix_column(dataset)
1519        if dataset is None or not column:
1520            return [float(epoch) for epoch in epochs]
1521
1522        series = pd.to_numeric(dataset.df[column], errors="coerce")
1523        xs: list[float] = []
1524        for epoch in epochs:
1525            try:
1526                value = series.iloc[int(epoch)]
1527            except Exception:
1528                value = float("nan")
1529            if pd.notna(value):
1530                xs.append(float(value))
1531            else:
1532                xs.append(float(epoch))
1533        return xs
1534
1535    def _timing_target_column_candidates(self, dataset: ObserverDataset | None = None) -> list[str]:
1536        """
1537        Return numeric observer columns that are plausible ground-truth targets for the currently active timing model.
1538
1539        Args:
1540            dataset (ObserverDataset | None): Dataset object to inspect, mutate, cache, or select.
1541
1542        Returns:
1543            list[str]: Numeric columns that may supply observed target values.
1544        """
1545        candidates: list[str] = []
1546        for value in (self.active_target_name, self.selected_target_name):
1547            if value and value not in candidates:
1548                candidates.append(str(value))
1549        preferred = [
1550            "path_delay",
1551            "propagation_delay",
1552            "prop_delay",
1553            "time_sync_error",
1554            "clock_error",
1555            "delay",
1556            "target",
1557        ]
1558        for value in preferred:
1559            if value not in candidates:
1560                candidates.append(value)
1561        if dataset is not None and dataset.y_column and dataset.y_column not in candidates:
1562            candidates.append(dataset.y_column)
1563        return candidates
1564
1565    def _available_timing_target_column(self) -> tuple[ObserverDataset | None, str]:
1566        """
1567        Return the active observer dataset and first available numeric target column that matches the timing-model target.
1568
1569        Returns:
1570            tuple[ObserverDataset | None, str | None]: Dataset and matching target column available for overlay, if any.
1571        """
1572        dataset = self.active_observer_dataset()
1573        if dataset is None or dataset.df.empty:
1574            return None, ""
1575        lookup = {str(col).strip().lower(): str(col) for col in dataset.df.columns}
1576        for candidate in self._timing_target_column_candidates(dataset):
1577            column = lookup.get(str(candidate).strip().lower())
1578            if not column:
1579                continue
1580            series = pd.to_numeric(dataset.df[column], errors="coerce")
1581            if series.notna().sum() >= 2:
1582                return dataset, column
1583        return dataset, ""
1584
1585    def timing_target_overlay_status(self) -> tuple[bool, str]:
1586        """
1587        Return whether a target overlay can be shown and provide a UI-ready explanation of the detected target column.
1588
1589        Returns:
1590            tuple[bool, str]: Whether target overlay is available and a UI-ready status message.
1591        """
1592        dataset, column = self._available_timing_target_column()
1593        if dataset is None:
1594            return False, "Load a dataset with a numeric target column to enable target overlay."
1595        if column:
1596            return True, f"Target overlay available from '{column}' in '{dataset.name}'."
1597        if self.active_target_name:
1598            return False, f"No numeric '{self.active_target_name}' column is available in '{dataset.name}'."
1599        return False, f"No numeric timing target column is available in '{dataset.name}'."
1600
1601    def current_timing_target_overlay(self, xs: list[float]) -> tuple[list[float], list[float], str]:
1602        """
1603        Return x/y target-overlay arrays aligned to the generated timing predictions when the right-axis overlay is enabled.
1604
1605        Args:
1606            list[float]: Generated timing x-axis values used to align returned target observations.
1607
1608        Returns:
1609            tuple[list[float], list[float], str]: Aligned target x/y values and the column name used for the overlay.
1610        """
1611        if not self.timing_plot_show_target:
1612            return [], [], ""
1613        dataset, column = self._available_timing_target_column()
1614        if dataset is None or not column or len(xs) < 1:
1615            return [], [], ""
1616        series = pd.to_numeric(dataset.df[column], errors="coerce")
1617        count = min(len(xs), len(series))
1618        target_xs: list[float] = []
1619        target_ys: list[float] = []
1620        for idx in range(count):
1621            value = series.iloc[idx]
1622            if pd.notna(value):
1623                target_xs.append(float(xs[idx]))
1624                target_ys.append(float(value))
1625        if len(target_xs) < 2:
1626            return [], [], ""
1627        return target_xs, target_ys, column

1708    def apply_model_config(self, config: ChannelModelConfig) -> None:
1709        """
1710        Validate and activate a selected timing or polarization model configuration, then reset stale observer output.
1711
1712        Args:
1713            config (ChannelModelConfig): Timing or polarization model configuration to activate.
1714        """
1715        if config.model_family not in {"timing", "polarization"}:
1716            self.set_status("Select a model family first: timing or polarization.")
1717            return
1718        try:
1719            self.backend.configure_channel_model(config)
1720            self.backend.reset()
1721            self._clear_plot_state()
1722            self._set_plot_label_for_config(config)
1723            self.set_status(f"Applied {config.model_family} model config '{config.model_name}' ({config.mode})")
1724        except Exception as exc:
1725            self.set_status(f"Model config failed: {exc}")

1727    def train_and_activate_model(self) -> None:
1728        """Train a new model from the selected CSV columns, save its bundle, and activate it in the configured model family."""
1729        family = self.selected_model_family
1730        if family is None:
1731            self.set_status("Select a model family first: timing or polarization.")
1732            return
1733        train_fraction, validation_fraction, test_fraction = self.current_split_fractions()
1734        config = ChannelModelConfig(
1735            mode="new",
1736            model_family=family,
1737            model_name=self.new_model_name.strip() or "my_model",
1738            epochs=int(self.new_epochs),
1739            learning_rate=float(self.new_lr),
1740            feature_names=self.selected_feature_names,
1741            target_name=self.selected_target_name,
1742            model_kind=self.selected_model_kind,
1743            model_params=self.current_model_params(),
1744            train_fraction=train_fraction,
1745            validation_fraction=validation_fraction,
1746            test_fraction=test_fraction,
1747        )
1748        try:
1749            summary = dict(self.backend.train_channel_model(config) or {})
1750            self.last_training_summary = summary
1751
1752            active_name = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(self.csv_path))[0] if self.csv_path else "active_dataset"
1753            active_ds = self.observer_dataset_by_name(active_name)
1754            if active_ds is not None and config.target_name:
1755                if config.target_name in active_ds.df.columns:
1756                    active_ds.y_column = config.target_name
1757
1758            self.backend.reset()
1759            self._clear_plot_state()
1760            self._set_plot_label_for_config(config)
1761            self.set_status(
1762                f"Trained {config.model_family} {SUPPORTED_MODEL_KINDS.get(config.model_kind, config.model_kind)} as '{config.model_name}'. "
1763                f"Train RMSE={summary.get('train_rmse', float('nan')):.4g}, "
1764                f"Val RMSE={summary.get('validation_rmse', float('nan')):.4g}, "
1765                f"Test RMSE={summary.get('test_rmse', float('nan')):.4g}"
1766            )
1767        except Exception as exc:
1768            self.set_status(f"Training failed: {exc}")
1769

1779            path = self._ask_save_path(
1780                                    title="Save Trained Model",
1781                                default_filename=f"{safe_name}.joblib",
1782                            default_extension=".joblib",
1783                        filters=["*.joblib", "*"],
1784                    initial_dir=model_dir)
1785
1786            if not path:
1787                self.set_status("Model save cancelled.")
1788                return
1789
1790            self.backend.save_current_model(path)
1791            self.existing_model_path = path
1792            self.set_status(f"Saved trained model to: {path}")
1793        except Exception as exc:
1794            self.set_status(f"Save model failed: {exc}")
1795
1796    # others helpers (drawing, etc)
1797    # TODO: Add more shortcuts (and menu options)
1798    def _shortcut_ctrl_a(self) -> bool:
1799        """Detect a Ctrl+A keypress once and request the About dialog."""
1800        if self.window is None:
1801            return False
1802        ctrl = (
1803            glfw.get_key(self.window, glfw.KEY_LEFT_CONTROL) == glfw.PRESS
1804            or glfw.get_key(self.window, glfw.KEY_RIGHT_CONTROL) == glfw.PRESS
1805        )
1806        a_key = glfw.get_key(self.window, glfw.KEY_A) == glfw.PRESS
1807        return ctrl and a_key
1808
1809    def _shortcut_ctrl_i(self) -> bool:
1810        """Detect a Ctrl+I keypress once and request the CSV import flow."""
1811        if self.window is None:
1812            return False
1813        ctrl = (
1814            glfw.get_key(self.window, glfw.KEY_LEFT_CONTROL) == glfw.PRESS
1815            or glfw.get_key(self.window, glfw.KEY_RIGHT_CONTROL) == glfw.PRESS
1816        )
1817        i_key = glfw.get_key(self.window, glfw.KEY_I) == glfw.PRESS
1818        return ctrl and i_key
1819
1820    def _model_type(self) -> str:
1821        """
1822        Return the model-source option selected in the configuration panel.
1823
1824        Returns:
1825            str: Selected model-source option label.
1826        """
1827        return self.model_type_options[self.model_type_idx]
1828
1829    def close_window(self) -> None:
1830        """Mark the GLFW window for closing when a window is active."""
1831        if self.window is not None and glfw is not None:
1832            glfw.set_window_should_close(self.window, True)
1833
1834    def draw_model_config_panel(self, width: int, height: int) -> None:
1835        """
1836        Delegate rendering of the model-configuration panel using this application controller as state.
1837
1838        Args:
1839            int: Requested width of the model-configuration panel.
1840            int: Requested height of the model-configuration panel.
1841        """
1842        draw_model_config_panel(self, width, height)
1843
1844    def draw(self) -> None:
1845        """Render one complete ImGui frame, including menu, observer, controls, dialogs, and model configuration. (See imgui docs for intuitive explanation as to how this works differently from previously-used tcl/tk)"""
1846        draw_menu_bar(self)
1847
1848        if self._shortcut_ctrl_a():
1849            if not self._ctrl_a_latched:
1850                self.want_about_popup = True
1851                self._ctrl_a_latched = True
1852        else:
1853            self._ctrl_a_latched = False
1854
1855        if self._shortcut_ctrl_i():
1856            if not self._ctrl_i_latched:
1857                self.want_import_csv = True
1858                self._ctrl_i_latched = True
1859        else:
1860            self._ctrl_i_latched = False
1861
1862        if self.want_import_csv:
1863            self.want_import_csv = False
1864            self.import_csv()
1865
1866        imgui.set_next_window_position(10, 30)
1867        imgui.set_next_window_size(1120, 520)
1868        imgui.begin(
1869            "Simulation",
1870            flags=(
1871                imgui.WINDOW_NO_TITLE_BAR
1872                | imgui.WINDOW_NO_RESIZE
1873                | imgui.WINDOW_NO_MOVE
1874                | imgui.WINDOW_NO_COLLAPSE
1875            ),
1876        )
1877        right_panel_width = 360.0
1878        total_width = imgui.get_window_width()
1879        left_panel_width = max(300.0, total_width - right_panel_width - 36.0)
1880
1881        imgui.columns(2, "main_cols", border=True)
1882        imgui.set_column_width(0, left_panel_width)
1883
1884        draw_left_panel(self)
1885        imgui.next_column()
1886        draw_right_panel(self)
1887
1888        imgui.columns(1)
1889        imgui.end()
1890
1891        # Draw overlays after the base win so they cant get stuck behind it
1892        draw_about_popup(self)
1893        draw_import_csv_picker_window(self)
1894        draw_import_format_window(self)
1895        draw_data_processing_window(self)
1896        draw_csv_headers_window(self)

Own the state and orchestration logic for the simtwo ImGui application. The controller bridges GUI panels to simulation backends, data-processing operations, trained models, and rendered observer textures.

Percentage of samples remaining for the test split after the configured training and validation percentages.

def current_split_fractions(self) -> tuple[float, float, float]: 
284    def current_split_fractions(self) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
285        """
286        Clamp the configured train/validation percentages to a valid partition and return normalized train, validation, and test fractions.
287
288        Returns:
289            tuple[float, float, float]: Valid train, validation, and test fractions that sum to one.
290        """
291        train_pct = max(1, min(98, int(self.split_train_pct)))
292        max_val = max(1, 99 - train_pct)
293        validation_pct = max(1, min(max_val, int(self.split_validation_pct)))
294
295        if train_pct + validation_pct >= 100:
296            validation_pct = max(1, 99 - train_pct)
297
298        self.split_train_pct = train_pct
299        self.split_validation_pct = validation_pct
300        test_pct = max(1, 100 - train_pct - validation_pct)
301
302        return train_pct / 100.0, validation_pct / 100.0, test_pct / 100.0

Clamp the configured train/validation percentages to a valid partition and return normalized train, validation, and test fractions.

def generate(self, *, status_prefix: str = 'Generated') -> None: 
456    def generate(self, *, status_prefix: str = "Generated") -> None:
457        """
458        Run the active backend once over its loaded data, capture all callback outputs, and build a new static observer texture.
459
460        Args:
461            status_prefix (str): Prefix used in the status message after batch generation completes.
462        """
463        if self.active_model_family not in {"timing", "polarization"}:
464            self.set_status("Select a model family and apply a model before generating the observer plot.")
465            return
466
467        try:
468            self.backend.reset()
469            self._clear_plot_state()
470            with self.ui.lock:
471                self.ui.running = True
472            self.backend.start(self.cb_plot, self.cb_conditions, self.cb_poincare)
473            with self.ui.lock:
474                point_count = len(self.ui.poincare_states) if self.active_model_family == "polarization" else len(self.ui.times)
475                self.ui.running = False
476            self.capture_generated_plot_data()
477            if self.active_model_family == "polarization":
478                self.apply_polarization_distribution_selection()
479            self.rebuild_generated_plot_texture()

def rebuild_generated_plot_texture(self) -> None: 
519    def rebuild_generated_plot_texture(self) -> None:
520        """Create a fresh timing or Poincare texture from stored generated data and current plot settings."""
521        self.clear_generated_plot_texture()
522        try:
523            if self.active_model_family == "polarization":
524                if not self.generated_poincare_states:
525                    self.observer_plot_message = "Press Generate after applying a polarization model."
526                    return
527                self.clamp_applied_polarization_distribution_controls()
528                texture_id, width, height = create_poincare_plot_texture(
529                    self.generated_poincare_states,
530                    width=700,
531                    height=360,
532                    start_index=self.applied_polarization_distribution_start_idx,
533                    window_size=self.applied_polarization_distribution_window_size,
534                )
535                self.observer_plot_texture_id = texture_id
536                self.observer_plot_texture_width = width
537                self.observer_plot_texture_height = height
538                self.observer_plot_footer = self.current_poincare_footer_text()
539                self.observer_plot_message = ""
540                return
541
542            if self.active_model_family == "timing":
543                if len(self.generated_timing_xs) < 2 or len(self.generated_timing_ys) < 2:
544                    self.observer_plot_message = "Press Generate after applying a timing model."
545                    return
546                texture_id, width, height = create_timing_plot_texture(
547                    self.generated_timing_xs,
548                    self.generated_timing_ys,
549                    width=1100,
550                    height=320,
551                    title=self.timing_plot_title,
552                    title_font_size=self.timing_plot_title_font_size,
553                    x_axis_label=self.timing_plot_x_axis_label,
554                    x_axis_font_size=self.timing_plot_x_axis_font_size,
555                    y_axis_label=self.timing_plot_y_axis_label,
556                    y_axis_font_size=self.timing_plot_y_axis_font_size,
557                    tick_frequency=self.timing_plot_tick_frequency,
558                    tick_font_size=self.timing_plot_tick_font_size,
559                    target_xs=self.generated_target_xs,
560                    target_ys=self.generated_target_ys,
561                    target_label=f"Actual {self.generated_target_column}" if self.generated_target_column else "Target",
562                    target_y_axis_label=self.timing_plot_target_y_axis_label,
563                    target_y_axis_font_size=self.timing_plot_target_y_axis_font_size,
564                )
565                self.observer_plot_texture_id = texture_id
566                self.observer_plot_texture_width = width
567                self.observer_plot_texture_height = height
568                self.observer_plot_footer = ""
569                self.observer_plot_message = ""
570                return
571
572            self.observer_plot_message = "Press Generate after applying a model."
573        except Exception as exc:
574            self.observer_plot_message = f"Plot rendering failed: {exc}"

def current_poincare_footer_text(self) -> str: 
576    def current_poincare_footer_text(self) -> str:
577        """
578        Describe the currently applied Poincarr distribution window in a footer suitable for the observer panel.
579
580        Returns:
581            str: Description of the applied Poincare distribution window.
582        """
583        count = len(self.generated_poincare_states)
584        if count <= 0:
585            return ""
586        self.clamp_applied_polarization_distribution_controls()
587        start = int(self.applied_polarization_distribution_start_idx)
588        end = min(count, start + int(self.applied_polarization_distribution_window_size))
589        used = max(0, end - start)
590        return f"Distribution window: observations {start}–{max(start, end - 1)} of {count} ({used} sample(s))"

592    def clamp_polarization_distribution_controls(self) -> None:

598        self.polarization_distribution_start_idx = max(0, min(int(self.polarization_distribution_start_idx), max_start))

1360            safe_name = "".join(ch if ch.isalnum() or ch in ("-", "_") else "_" for ch in ds.name) or "dataset"

1362            ds.df.to_csv(out_path, index=False)

def current_timing_plot_xs(self, epochs: list[int]) -> list[float]: 
1504    def current_timing_plot_xs(self, epochs: list[int]) -> list[float]:
1505        """
1506        Return timing-plot x values using epochs or aligned POSIX-time values according to the selected axis mode.
1507
1508        Args:
1509            epochs (list[int]): Generated epoch indices used when POSIX time is not selected.
1510
1511        Returns:
1512            list[float]: X-axis values aligned to generated timing predictions.
1513        """
1514        if self.selected_timing_x_axis_mode != "posix_time":
1515            return [float(epoch) for epoch in epochs]
1516
1517        dataset = self.active_observer_dataset()
1518        column = self._timing_posix_column(dataset)
1519        if dataset is None or not column:
1520            return [float(epoch) for epoch in epochs]
1521
1522        series = pd.to_numeric(dataset.df[column], errors="coerce")
1523        xs: list[float] = []
1524        for epoch in epochs:
1525            try:
1526                value = series.iloc[int(epoch)]
1527            except Exception:
1528                value = float("nan")
1529            if pd.notna(value):
1530                xs.append(float(value))
1531            else:
1532                xs.append(float(epoch))
1533        return xs

def current_timing_target_overlay(self, xs: list[float]) -> tuple[list[float], list[float], str]: 
1601    def current_timing_target_overlay(self, xs: list[float]) -> tuple[list[float], list[float], str]:
1602        """
1603        Return x/y target-overlay arrays aligned to the generated timing predictions when the right-axis overlay is enabled.
1604
1605        Args:
1606            list[float]: Generated timing x-axis values used to align returned target observations.
1607
1608        Returns:
1609            tuple[list[float], list[float], str]: Aligned target x/y values and the column name used for the overlay.
1610        """
1611        if not self.timing_plot_show_target:
1612            return [], [], ""
1613        dataset, column = self._available_timing_target_column()
1614        if dataset is None or not column or len(xs) < 1:
1615            return [], [], ""
1616        series = pd.to_numeric(dataset.df[column], errors="coerce")
1617        count = min(len(xs), len(series))
1618        target_xs: list[float] = []
1619        target_ys: list[float] = []
1620        for idx in range(count):
1621            value = series.iloc[idx]
1622            if pd.notna(value):
1623                target_xs.append(float(xs[idx]))
1624                target_ys.append(float(value))
1625        if len(target_xs) < 2:
1626            return [], [], ""
1627        return target_xs, target_ys, column

Return x/y target-overlay arrays aligned to the generated timing predictions when the right-axis overlay is enabled.

1910
1911    glfw.init()
1912
1913    glfw.window_hint(glfw.RESIZABLE, glfw.FALSE)
1914    window = glfw.create_window(1150, 600, "simtwo - ImGui GUI", None, None)
1915    if not window:

1917        raise RuntimeError("Could not create GLFW window")
1918
1919    glfw.make_context_current(window)
1920    glfw.swap_interval(1)
1921
1922    imgui.create_context()
1923    impl = GlfwRenderer(window)
1924
1925    app = SimImGuiApp(backend)
1926    app.window = window
1927
1928    # main app loop:
